objective: Test whether A-share market extreme-breadth structure and exchange-published margin-financing state add stable point-in-time information for future returns of domestic risk-asset ETFs beyond each ETF's own lagged momentum.

point_in_time.market_breadth: Trading-day T final breadth facts are first usable on the next A-share trading day T+1.
point_in_time.margin: SSE/SZSE trading-day T margin summary facts are first usable on the next A-share trading day T+1.
point_in_time.local_controls: ETF momentum controls use closes no later than D-1; forward labels start at ETF open on D.

research_boundary: No signal may generate risk permission, Trial/Confirm, amount, sell action, portfolio target, MASTER override or production decision-context integration. Any Stage1 passer must later be tested against validated ETF share-flow evidence before conversion discussion.
